Auferat fornicationes suas a facie sua,
Let her remove her fornications from before her face
et adulteria sua de medio uberum suorum;
and her adulteries from between her breasts.
ne forte expoliem eam nudam, et statuam eam secundum diem nativitatis suæ,
Otherwise, I may expose her nakedness and set her as on the day of her birth,
et ponam eam quasi solitudinem, et statuam eam velut terram inviam,
and I may establish her as a wilderness and set her as an impassable land,

And I will not have mercy on her sons,
for they are the sons of fornications.
For their mother has been fornicating;
she who conceived them has been brought to ruin.
Propter hoc ecce ego sepiam viam tuam spinis,
Because of this, behold, I will fence in your way with thorns,
and I will surround it with a wall,
and she will not find her paths.
And she will pursue her lovers,
but she will not obtain them,
but she will not find them,
‘I will go and return to my first husband,
et revertar ad virum meum priorem,
because it was to some extent better for me then,
quia bene mihi erat tunc magis quam nunc.
Et hæc nescivit, quia ego dedi ei frumentum, et vinum,
And she did not know that I gave her grain and wine and oil,
et oleum, et argentum multiplicavi ei,
and that I increased her silver and gold,
et sumam frumentum meum in tempore suo,
et vinum meum in tempore suo.
and I will take away my grain in its time and my wine in its time,
Et liberabo lanam meam et linum meum,
and I will set free my wool and my flax,
Et nunc revelabo stultitiam ejus in oculis amatorum ejus;
And now, I will reveal her foolishness by the eyes of her lovers,
et vir non eruet eam de manu mea;
and no man will rescue her from my hand.
et cessare faciam omne gaudium ejus,
And I will cause all her joy to cease:
And I will corrupt her vines and her fig trees,
my lovers have given them to me.’
And I will place her in a narrow forest,
and the beasts of the field will devour her.
Et visitabo super eam dies Baalim,
And I will inflict on her the days of the Baals,
Propter hoc ecce ego lactabo eam,
“Because of this, behold, I will attract her,
and I will lead her into the wilderness,
and I will speak to her heart.
Et dabo ei vinitores ejus ex eodem loco,
And I will give to her, from the same place, her vinedressers,
et vallem Achor, ad aperiendam spem;
and the valley of Achor as a passage of hope.
et canet ibi juxta dies juventutis suæ,
And she will sing there as in the days of her youth,
et juxta dies ascensionis suæ de terra Ægypti.
and as in the days of her ascension from the land of Egypt.
And it will be in that day,”
says the Lord, “that she will call me,
et non vocabit me ultra Baali.
and she will no longer call me, ‘My Baal.’
Et auferam nomina Baalim de ore ejus,
And I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth,
et non recordabitur ultra nominis eorum.
and she will no longer remember their name.
Et percutiam cum eis fœdus in die illa,
I will strike a deal with them,
with the beasts of the field,
and with the birds of the sky,
and with the creatures of the earth.
And I will crush the bow and the sword,
and I will wipe away war from the earth.
And I will let them sleep securely.
Et sponsabo te mihi in sempiternum;

et sponsabo te mihi in justitia,
and I will betroth you to me in justice
Et sponsabo te mihi in fide;
And I will wed you to me in faith,

And this will happen in that day:
and they will hear the earth.
And the land will pay attention to the grain,
Et seminabo eam mihi in terra,
And I will plant her for me in the land,
